purpose: Remove all filter and spark plug imagery and dedicated image frames from presentation screenshots.

prompts.catalog:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: screenshot used in a portfolio, a presentation concept of a local employee-only auto parts inventory application.
Primary request: REMOVE all product imagery and its dedicated image container/frame. Keep the entire surrounding application intact. This is a SMALL TARGETED EDIT, not another redesign.
Input image: the single attached screenshot is the EDIT TARGET.
Preserve: exact overall landscape aspect ratio and resolution, dark slate/graphite palette, typography, sidebar logo/nav, all labels, numbers, part names, SKUs, table, search/filter controls, buttons and blue-purple selection colors. Keep text crisp and readable.
Do not crop the screenshot or change the app navigation, spacing elsewhere, colors, controls or data. Do not introduce any photo, illustration, thumbnail, replacement icon, placeholder box, empty image frame or blank reserved picture area. Functional non-product interface icons may stay.
Critical: no mention/logo/URL of Armtek, Армтек, Stparts, Стпартс or variations.
Specific edits: In the RIGHT selected part panel headed “ВЫБРАННАЯ ДЕТАЛЬ / Масляный фильтр”, REMOVE the black oil filter image and the ENTIRE image area between this heading and the Артикул/Бренд/На складе details. Collapse this area so the specifications start below the heading with a normal 24px gap. Move the remaining specification list, price, compatibility and actions upwards to form a balanced compact text-only detail panel. Shorten the outer detail panel height to fit its remaining content; any space below it should simply be the surrounding application background, not an empty image area. The rest of the screenshot remains exactly the same. No oil filter picture anywhere.
